myDayStep.title: My Day
myDayStep.privacyCaption: Only you can see what you write here.

skillLevel.title: Practice level
skillLevel.subtitle: Shows what difficulty each skill is practicing at right now. It rises as they do well, and eases back gently when it's hard, so it always stays at the right level.
skillLevel.excludedNote: Only activities with difficulty levels show here. (Excludes {{excluded}})

sessionCompletion.title: Practice completion
sessionCompletion.subtitle: The share of started practices finished all the way through. Practices stopped partway are still counted up to however far they got.
sessionCompletion.dropoffNote: Practices stopped partway got to about {{items}} items on average. If it keeps stopping around the same spot, that's usually where it gets hard.
sessionCompletion.streakDisclaimer: ‘Days practiced’ on the patient home counts any day with at least one item answered. That's a different measure than completion rate here.
